::: {.intro}
I am a control theorist currently serving as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at
[Monash University](https://www.monash.edu/) (Clayton), working with
[A/Prof. Liz Ratnam](https://www.monash.edu/engineering/lizratnam).

I obtained a PhD in Engineering from the
[Australian National University](https://www.anu.edu.au) for my work on **negative imaginary systems theory** and its applications, under the supervision of [Prof. Ian Petersen](https://eng.anu.edu.au/people/ian-petersen) and the co-supervision of [Dr. Igor Vladimirov](https://eng.anu.edu.au/people/igor-vladimirov).

Prior to joining Monash University, I was a Postdoctoral Research Associate at the [University of Sydney](https://www.sydney.edu.au/), where I worked with [Prof. Ian Manchester](https://www.sydney.edu.au/engineering/about/our-people/academic-staff/ian-manchester.html).

My research interests include nonlinear systems, discrete-time systems, hybrid systems, learning-based control, multi-agent systems, and power systems.
:::
